sourceState: Reviewed working tree; root owns final commit, central mirror sync and final combined tests.
ui: Existing components/layout preserved. Necessary permission/loading/error/retry/pagination/navigation repairs only.

classificationRules.PASS: Only the stated local execution or source assertion passed.
classificationRules.FAIL: A current executed check reproduced a defect.
classificationRules.NOT_VERIFIED: The required hosted/provider/device acceptance was not run.

testRuns.scope: Executed local actual-handler/source fixtures with synthetic transports; no hosted production writes
tests: successful CMS publication remains published when public readback fails
a lost CMS publication response is reported as unconfirmed and requires reload
same-tick CMS publication taps issue one write and disabled/loading editors issue none
same-tick draft saves issue one write and preserve readback uncertainty
deferred asset picking keeps the original field and locks duplicate picker calls
delayed edits preserve the latest draft instead of overwriting intervening changes
builders with the same store-scoped ID resolve to the intended merchant and save original protocol IDs
shared Goodies onboarding, restriction and CMS RPCs hide returned and thrown server details
courier removal with a picked-up delivery shows the owned action message
failed operations, business and restriction RPCs render an honest retry state instead of empty success
retrying the real snapshot boundary recovers the successful list after a failed load
late snapshot responses cannot overwrite a newer load or a different admin session
operational and financial handlers reject insufficient grants before alerts or writes
fee inputs reject malformed tip presets and fractional stop limits without publishing a different policy
a late operational page cannot replace a newer page or data for a new admin
invalid financial responses never become a displayed zero or settlement amount
same-tick operational taps dispatch once and late responses do not update a different admin
saved confirmation dialogs cannot mutate after switching admin accounts
malformed review pages show an error and late pages do not replace current account data
an uncertain CMS asset-record response preserves the successfully uploaded object
a builder image picker runs once and keeps the selected merchant scope
settlement reads and destination responses cannot expose the previous admin session
ingredient asset IDs do not require a native global Web Crypto API
ingredient decisions require an explanatory note and asset permission where needed
ingredient photo actions lock the whole picker and preserve the submitted name
builder ingredient choices load requests beyond the old cap and reject overlapping pages
ingredient request filtering is applied by the backend before paging and stale responses are ignored
every advertised Goodies hub module opens its connected destination rather than a stale or placeholder tab
Goodies support pages use the shared real inbox and ignore stale page or account responses
support status writes lock duplicate taps and require one confirmed Goodies ticket

testRuns.scope: Executed local actual-handler/source fixtures with synthetic transports; no hosted production writes
tests: every listed Goodies workspace section opens a supported live admin module
Goodies support, categories, promotions and settings do not fall into the prototype workspace
an unknown Goodies module fails safely to Overview rather than another service
admin invitation acceptance uses server-owned staff state, never editable user metadata

testRuns.scope: Executed local actual-handler/source fixtures with synthetic transports; no hosted production writes
tests: financial confirmation validates the transferred currency amount and requires receipt evidence
admin settlement actions send exact receipt amounts and never expose backend errors

testRuns.scope: Executed local actual-handler/source fixtures with synthetic transports; no hosted production writes
tests: Shared Bill refund parsing rejects corrupt amounts rather than displaying zero
Shared Bill refund retry needs finance permission and a review reason before dispatch
Shared Bill refund retry uses a synchronous lock and reports a pending refund accurately
Shared Bill refund failures and stale list responses cannot expose private server details
a refund retry response cannot update a different signed-in admin

notVerified: Every hosted signed-in admin control and cross-role permission path
Production SQL/RLS deployment and hosted acceptance (root owns backend review)
CMS publication through installed-customer reload; FAQ/legal publishing deferred
Signed builds and real device file-picker behavior
External transfer/provider execution and financial reconciliation
